questions.analysis: 本题为七选五阅读填空题，考查上下文逻辑衔接。题干提到“排名较低的大学在教学方面得分高于排名较高的大学”，这一发现与通常认为排名高即教学好的预期相反。选项D“然而，排名忽略了一个关键因素：教学质量”直接点明排名与教学质量的矛盾，与题干形成转折关系，符合逻辑。其他选项：A与题干无关；B谈论教学在招聘中的价值，不衔接；C强调教学质量对声誉的作用，但未回应排名矛盾；E讨论近期改进教学的努力，不直接相关；F提到人们对教学被低估的惊讶，但主语“they”指代不明；G说大学将重点从教学转向其他排名因素，虽相关但不如D直接解释题干现象。解题思路：先理解题干核心矛盾（排名与教学得分不一致），再找能解释或转折这一现象的选项。语法点：转折连词“However”的使用；词汇：rankings（排名）、critical factor（关键因素）、quality of teaching（教学质量）。

questions.analysis: 本题为七选五阅读填空题，考查上下文逻辑衔接和语篇连贯能力。题干句子前有空格，后接“Nevertheless, not much will change until schools with high-quality teaching are rewarded...”，意为“然而，除非高质量教学的学校得到更多资源、更高排名和更多招生，否则不会有太大改变”。空格处需填入一个与后文形成转折关系的句子。选项G“In fact, universities often shift emphasis from teaching to other ranking factors.”（事实上，大学经常将重点从教学转向其他排名因素）与后文“Nevertheless”形成转折：前句指出大学忽视教学，后句转折说除非教学被重视否则不会改变。其他选项：A说高等教育已实现潜力，与后文矛盾；B说教学在招聘中不被重视，但后文未涉及招聘；C说教学质量是声誉因素，与转折逻辑不符；D说排名忽视教学，但后文已提到排名；E说近期出现改进教学的努力，与“not much will change”矛盾；F说他们对教学被低估更惊讶，主语不一致。因此G最符合逻辑。语法点：转折连词“Nevertheless”提示前后语义相反；词汇：“shift emphasis from...to...”意为“将重点从……转向……”。解题思路：先理解空格后句意，再找与之逻辑匹配的选项，注意转折关系。

But through repetition, it’s possible to form new habits. The amount of time needed to build a habit will depend on multiple factors, including the individual and the intended behaviour. While you are able to pickup a new habit in a few weeks, it takes many months to build a healthy habit. Take some time to think about what leads to bad habits and re﹣evaluate what you get out of them (or don’t). questions.stem: 阅读下面短文，根据题目要求用英文回答问题。Habit formation is the process by which behaviours become automatic. People develop countless habits as they explore the world, whether they are aware of them or not. Understanding how habits take shape may be helpful in changing bad habits.Habits are built through learning and repetition. A person is thought to develop a habit in the course of pursuing goals by beginning to associate certain cues(刺激) with behavioural responses that help meet the goal. Over time, thoughts of the behaviour and ultimately the behaviour itself are likely to be triggered(触发) by these cues.A “habit loop(环)” is a way of describing several related elements that produce habits. These elements are called the cue, the routine, and the reward. For example, stress could serve as a cue that one responds to by eating, which produces the reward﹣the reduction of stress. While a routine involves repeated behaviour, it’s not necessarily performed in response to a deep﹣rooted urge, as a habit is.Old habits can be difficult to shake, and healthy habits are often harder to develop. But through repetition, it’s possible to form new habits. The amount of time needed to build a habit will depend on multiple factors, including the individual and the intended behaviour. While you are able to pickup a new habit in a few weeks, it takes many months to build a healthy habit. Take some time to think about what leads to bad habits and re﹣evaluate what you get out of them (or don’t). Consider and keep in mind why you want to make a change, including how the change reflects your values.(1) What is a “habit loop”? (2分)(2) How are habits built according to the passage? (2分)(3) What is the difference between a routine and a habit? (3分)(4) What advice does the author give to change bad habits? (5分)
questions.answer: (1) A “habit loop” is a way of describing several related elements that produce habits, including the cue, the routine, and the reward.(2) Habits are built through learning and repetition, by associating certain cues with behavioural responses that help meet goals.(3) A routine involves repeated behaviour but is not necessarily performed in response to a deep-rooted urge, while a habit is triggered by cues and is automatic.(4) The author advises to think about what leads to bad habits, re-evaluate what you get out of them, consider why you want to make a change, and keep in mind how the change reflects your values.
questions.analysis: 本题为阅读理解简答题，考查信息提取与概括能力。(1) 题干问“habit loop”的定义。原文第三段第一句明确给出定义：“A ‘habit loop’ is a way of describing several related elements that produce habits.” 后文列举了cue, routine, reward三个要素。答案需直接引用定义并补充要素。(2) 题干问习惯如何形成。原文第二段第一句“Habits are built through learning and repetition.” 以及后文“by beginning to associate certain cues with behavioural responses that help meet the goal”提供了具体机制。答案需概括这两个要点。(3) 题干问routine和habit的区别。原文第三段最后一句指出：“While a routine involves repeated behaviour, it’s not necessarily performed in response to a deep-rooted urge, as a habit is.” 关键区别在于habit由深层冲动触发且自动，routine则不一定。(4) 题干问作者对改变坏习惯的建议。原文最后一段最后两句：“Take some time to think about what leads to bad habits and re-evaluate what you get out of them (or don’t). Consider and keep in mind why you want to make a change, including how the change reflects your values.” 答案需提取这些建议。语法点：被动语态（are built, is triggered）、定语从句（that produce habits）、条件状语从句（while引导）。词汇：habit loop, cue, routine, reward, trigger, deep-rooted urge。解题思路：定位原文关键句，提取核心信息，用简洁英语回答。

questions.analysis: 本题考察对'routine'和'habit'两个词汇的辨析。'Routine'指日常例行事务，通常是有意识安排的一系列活动，强调计划性和顺序性；'habit'指习惯，是无意识或自动化的行为，通常由特定情境或线索触发。解题思路：理解两者核心区别——routine强调有意识的安排，habit强调无意识的自动反应。语法点：名词辨析；词汇用法：routine常与daily搭配，habit常与bad/good搭配。

假设你是红星中学高三学生李华。你的英国好友Jim正在策划一次以“绿色北京”为主题的社团活动，他发来邮件询问你的建议。请你用英文给他回复，内容包括：(1)活动形式；(2)活动内容。注意：(1)词数100左右；(2)开头和结尾已给出，不计入总词数。Dear Jim，Yours，Li Hua
questions.answer: Dear Jim,I'm glad to hear about your "Green Beijing" club activity. I suggest organizing a tree-planting event in a local park, where we can plant native trees to improve air quality. Additionally, we could hold a workshop on recycling, teaching participants how to sort waste and reduce plastic use. These activities are practical and engaging, helping everyone contribute to a greener Beijing.Yours,Li Hua
questions.analysis: 本题为应用文写作，要求回复邮件，提出关于‘绿色北京’社团活动的建议。内容需包括活动形式和活动内容。语法点：建议句型（I suggest doing.../we could do...）、定语从句（where we can...）、非谓语动词（teaching...）。词汇用法：tree-planting（植树）、native trees（本地树种）、workshop（研讨会）、sort waste（垃圾分类）。解题思路：首先明确回复格式，开头已给出，需补充正文；其次紧扣‘绿色北京’主题，选择环保相关活动（如植树、垃圾分类）；最后注意词数100左右，语言简洁得体。难度中等，需结合环保常识和英语表达。
